To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we developed a novel method, called DAF, for predicting domain functions, which is based on the integration of multiple heterogeneous sources of data and (ii) DAF outperforms other existing methods in the prediction of domain functions.

we have developed an integrated approach to predict protein domain functions by combining heterogeneous information sources, including domain sequence profiles, domain structure information and domain interaction information, and have evaluated the performance of the proposed approach on two datasets, one of which is newly created.

we proposed a novel method for predicting protein domain function using heterogeneous information sources, including protein-protein interaction networks, protein domain interaction networks, protein sequences and protein structures.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of computational methods for the annotation of protein domain functions, which can be used to predict the functions for un-annotated domains, and thus to facilitate the functional genomics studies of proteins.
protein domain function prediction, which is a fundamental problem in the post-genome era.

there are no significant differences between the results of our method and those of the state-of-the-art methods.
the proposed method is a very good and promising approach for the annotation of domain functions.
the proposed approach is an effective way for protein domain function prediction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a computational method for protein domain annotation based on heterogeneous information sources.
we developed an integrated approach to predict domain functions by integrating various heterogeneous data.
we have proposed several computational approaches for predicting domain function based on the integration of various heterogeneous information sources.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of heterogeneous sources of information is a powerful way to predict the functions for protein domains.
the combination of different data types can help to predict domain functions.
the integration of heterogeneous information can significantly improve the accuracy of domain function prediction, and that the integration of different information sources should be done carefully.
